summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2025 Integrated Annual Report, which highlights record digital growth, strategic initiatives (Kyivstar Nasdaq listing, Starlink partnership, sovereign AI), and financial results (Group revenues +9.9% to $4,399M, EBITDA +18.8% to $2,009M). The filing is a routine annual report dissemination, not a special-situation event. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or corporate action triggering a special-situation category is present.
